info.title: IDPGitOps — F-004 Secret and token lifecycle events
info.description: Empty as a message contract. The one event-shaped thing in the whole survey belongs here in spirit — an Event Grid topic type on the Key Vault alert resources [D: terraform/akv_alerts.tf:47] — but it is infrastructure configuration consumed by Azure Monitor, not a channel this code publishes to or subscribes from. Recorded here so the absence is a stated fact.
